subject.title: fix: allow macOS gateway restart while LaunchAgent owns its port

question: Should direct `service.restart` callers continue to mean “request supervisor replacement,” with readiness guaranteed only by the CLI wrapper, or should OpenClaw introduce a cross-platform readiness guarantee for every direct caller?
rationale: The PR correctly removes a racy precondition for the LaunchAgent branch, but whether direct service-level callers must observe readiness is a persistent API and availability-contract choice that the narrow patch cannot safely decide alone.

options.title: Keep the existing service-operation contract
options.body: Merge this scoped repair and retain health waiting in the existing CLI restart flow while direct callers continue to own any readiness requirement.

options.title: Define universal restart readiness
options.body: Pause this PR and design a cross-platform service API that waits for or reports replacement health for every direct caller before completion.

recommendation.title: Keep the existing service-operation contract
recommendation.body: Merge this scoped repair and retain health waiting in the existing CLI restart flow while direct callers continue to own any readiness requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same LaunchAgent lifecycle path already distinguished stop postconditions from restart behavior.
